newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe rises again on debt-deal hopes.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe rises again on debt-deal hopes.

text.p: The Polish construction company Espebepe SA extended the last two session's 20 percent rise, jumping 9.3 percent to 5.9 zlotys as investors speculated that it might clinch a deal with its creditors, traders said.
"They speculate hoping that Espebepe would be rescued, but I'm afraid bankruptcy is still quite likely," one trader said.
The company's creditors are due to meet on May 16. Espebepe said on Tuesday it would offer its creditors a new debt restructuring plan envisaging a new issue.
Traders said reduced buy orders suggested the stock might extend its gains on Friday. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
